# Controller 1.0.51 (87)
## Goals everywhere
- Every harness now supports Controller goals, using native goal controls where available and Controller-driven goals where they are not. - Set a turn limit for each goal directly from the goal card.
## Faster composer and mobile transcript
- Removed a composer parsing path that could stall on long drafts with Unicode text or bridged strings. - Reduced SwiftUI work while scrolling and resizing long mobile conversations. - Improved queued prompt layout and made Codex steering take effect immediately.
## Harness improvements
- Kimi Code now appears at its native installation path, with supported reasoning efforts. - Added Claude Fast to the model controls and tightened Speed spacing. - Late Grok completion notifications no longer produce avoidable warnings.
Includes matching iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android build 87.

## Workspace storage reliability
- Fixes a startup recovery issue that could stop running chats and block new turns even when workspace storage was healthy. - Saves the latest checkpoint recovery state without flooding the write queue, preventing repeated recovery failures after relaunch. - Adds regression coverage for recovery, save retries, write ordering and running-turn continuity, plus clearer storage diagnostics.
Includes matching iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Android build 86.

## Controller 1.0.51 (85)
- **Kimi Code harness.** Kimi Code CLI is now available as a harness. It runs over ACP, lists its models, shows the real command in approval cards and supports Plan mode. Sign in with `kimi login` in Terminal. - **Built-in skills for Controller's own tools.** Six new built-in skills teach agents how to use Controller's threads, worktrees, pull requests, Connect Repos, browser, terminal, memory and workspace tools. - **Simulator paused for now.** The Simulator panel and the agent simulator tools are turned off while we fix reliability issues. Built-in skills no longer point agents to simulator tools while they are off.
